summary: GRID -, SUB - and NO MAP are drawn like buttons and each kept its reason in a title attribute, so on a phone — which reports hover: none — the reason could not be reached at all. 4,633 of the 7,680 rows in this cut carry the dashes and 26 carry NO MAP. Tapping one now prints its own sentence on its own line in the cell; the title stays put, so a mouse keeps the hover it had.
modification_note: Two edits in app.mjs — one helper and two lines added to the existing #tbody click delegate — and one appended block in orientation.css. The explanation shown is the chip’s own title attribute read back with textContent, never a second copy that could drift from it and never markup. No payload, no new asset, no render-time network call. Chips with no title stay inert rather than opening empty, and no chip’s wording, distance, colour or sort order changes.

registry_entry.mutates_existing_dashboard: the ACTIONS column non-answers become tappable and print their own reason
registry_entry.rule: An explanation that exists only in a title attribute does not exist on a device with no hover. Where a control's only content is the reason it has nothing to show, that reason must be reachable by the pointer the reader actually has. The reachable copy is read back from the attribute at the moment of the tap, so there is one sentence and not two that can drift apart.
registry_entry.found_by: sessions/202609031710-user-pain-log/00-PAIN.md, entries 7 and 8: 101 MAP taps on a verified coarse-pointer viewport — 393x852, devicePixelRatio 3, matchMedia(“(pointer: coarse)”) true, “(hover: hover)” false, maxTouchPoints 5. “56 of the 100 rows on screen show GRID - and SUB -. They are drawn in the same bordered boxes as MAP, NEWS and COPY ID, so they read as buttons. I tapped one. Nothing happened — no panel, no message, no change. There IS an explanation but it is a hover tooltip, and this phone reports hover: none. On a phone that sentence can never appear.” Entry 8 records the same for the NO MAP badge, which also sets cursor: not-allowed — a second signal a phone cannot render. Counted against releases/202609032251-pipelinenews on 2026-09-04: 4,633 of the 7,680 records are dashed on GRID and SUB, and 26 have geometry_status missing plus 2 invalid, which is what draws NO MAP.
